questions.embedding_text: Physics - Properties of Matter: A tension of 22N is applied to a copper wire of cross sectional area 0.02cm². Young's modulus of copper is 1.1×10¹¹ N/m² and Poisson's ratio 0.32. The decrease in cross sectional area will be: Options: 1.28×10⁻⁶ cm², 1.6×10⁻⁶ cm², 2.56×10⁻⁶ cm², 0.64×10⁻⁶ cm².
